description: Bet Slip Bug Fixes & Polish - Fix layout shifts, add decimal support, require all stakes, fix indicator styling, add re-use selections

userStories.title: Always show Place Bet button dimmed when disabled
userStories.description: As a player, I don't want the UI to shift when I start entering a stake — the Place Bet button should always be visible.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the `if canSubmit` conditional wrapping `submitSection` in stickyBottomSection (around line 567 of BetSlipSheet.swift)
Place Bet button is always rendered in the sticky bottom section regardless of canSubmit state
When canSubmit is false: button has 0.4 opacity via .opacity(canSubmit ? 1.0 : 0.4) and is .disabled(!canSubmit)
When canSubmit is true: button has full opacity and is enabled
No layout shift occurs when typing a stake amount
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Simple conditional removal + opacity/disabled modifiers. File: Booki/Views/BetSlipSheet.swift stickyBottomSection

userStories.title: Add decimal key to numeric keypad for cents entry
userStories.description: As a player, I want to enter cents (e.g. $25.50) on my wager.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom row of NumericKeypadView changes from [0, 00, backspace] to ['.', 0, backspace]
Decimal key inserts a '.' character into the text binding
If text already contains '.', tapping decimal key is a no-op (only one decimal allowed)
Maximum 2 digits after the decimal point — if text has '.XX' (2 decimal digits), number keys are no-op
Backspace deletes characters normally including the decimal point
The '00' key is removed entirely
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: File: Booki/Views/NumericKeypadView.swift. Validation logic goes in the key tap handler.

userStories.title: Require all singles bets to have stakes before submission
userStories.description: As a player, I should not be able to submit if some of my singles bets are missing stakes.
acceptanceCriteria: In canSubmit computed property (around line 821 of BetSlipSheet.swift), singles case checks that EVERY item in betSlipManager.items has a stake > 0
Use betSlipManager.getItemStake(marketId:sideIndicator:) to check each item's individual stake
If any single item has stake == 0, canSubmit returns false
Place Bet button stays dimmed/disabled until all singles have stakes set (works with US-001 always-visible button)
Parlay mode validation unchanged — only checks total stake > 0
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: File: Booki/Views/BetSlipSheet.swift canSubmit property. Iterate betSlipManager.items and check each.

userStories.title: Fix bet slip indicator to be a proper floating pill
userStories.description: As a player, I want the bet slip indicator to look like a floating button, not a partially hidden sheet.
acceptanceCriteria: GamesView betSlipIndicator (around line 249): add .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16)) or equivalent rounded corners
Add horizontal padding: .padding(.horizontal, 16) to the indicator wrapper
Add bottom padding so indicator sits above the tab bar with spacing (e.g. .padding(.bottom, 8))
Add shadow: .shadow(color: Theme.accent.opacity(0.3), radius: 8, x: 0, y: 4)
When betSlipManager.isEmpty, indicator is completely hidden with no partial visibility
Apply the same styling fixes to GameDetailView betSlipIndicator (around line 645)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Files: Booki/Views/GamesView.swift (betSlipIndicator ~line 249), Booki/Views/GameDetailView.swift (betSlipIndicator ~line 645). Both need identical fixes.

userStories.title: Add re-use selections CTA on success screen
userStories.description: As a player, I want to quickly re-add my same selections after placing a bet for a follow-up wager.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a @State property to store submitted items (e.g. `lastSubmittedItems: [BetSlipItem]`) — save betSlipManager.items before clearing on successful submission
On the success screen, add a text-only button 'Re-use selections' positioned above the 'Done' button
Button uses Theme.accent foreground color with no background (text-only link style)
Tapping it: re-adds each item from lastSubmittedItems via betSlipManager.add(), clears all itemStakeTexts and itemToWinTexts, sets submissionComplete = false to return to bet slip view
Stakes are reset to 0 (only selections are restored, not amounts)
If lastSubmittedItems is empty, button is hidden
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: File: Booki/Views/BetSlipSheet.swift. Save items in submitBets() before clearing. Success view is around line 1095.
